title: Claude can now watch videos
caption:
Claude can now watch videos. Really. 👀

This free GitHub plugin is called Watch (claude-video): paste a YouTube link or drop a file, and it pulls frames and a transcript so Claude sees what happens, second by second. Summaries, clips, notes, in seconds. Free and open-source (MIT). Not affiliated with the project or Claude.

Comment WATCH and I'll send you the link. Tag a friend who lives on YouTube. Follow @StickMindR8!

#opensource #github #aitools #claude #reelsinstagram
